name: Dzulkefly Ahmad
_note: M2 cohort expansion (key figures): Minister of Health since the 12 Dec 2023 reshuffle (also held the portfolio 2018-2020). Objective spine plus a provisional Layer B pass on file; below ranking validity pending remaining objective dimensions and an independent Layer B panel. Layer B (Editorial Panel) is a SINGLE-CODER provisional first-coder pass (coderScores length 1): each score is recorded and cited but NOT scored, normalized, or ranked, per methodology.validity.minCodersToScore=3. Citations verified to exist via search; article full text was not opened (environment fetch restriction), so facts rest on cross-outlet-corroborated search summaries and require primary-source reconfirmation before any independent panel finalizes the score.

metrics.justification: No personal corruption charge or conviction of record. The only court matter located is a defamation suit he brought as plaintiff (over a nepotism allegation), settled 9 Apr 2026 when the maker retracted the claim and accepted he had no involvement. Recorded as the subject's own factual status only.

citation.title: Najib settles defamation suit with Dzulkefly over nepotism claim

metrics.justification: Shapley-Shubik power index of the leader's coalition (Pakatan Harapan) among the seven blocs of the 222-seat Dewan Rakyat (GE15, simple-majority quota 112), computed by scripts/compute-pivotality.mjs. PH=0.4048, PN=BN=0.2214, GPS=0.0714. Coalition-level because per-party tallies carry a 1-2 seat contradiction immaterial to the index. Descriptive structural weight, not a merit score.

metrics.justification: Handling of supply crises: named Biocon as the cause of the 2024 human-insulin shortage and secured extra funding to substitute analogues, and moved to mandate six-month advance shortage notifications from Jul 2026; but he initially disputed the "shortage" framing on insulin and haemophilia treatment while patient groups reported rationing. Adequate response with mixed, contested outcomes (anchor 2).

citation.title: No insulin shortage for now, enough supplies to last till end of year, says Dr Dzul

metrics.justification: Delivered the contract-doctor permanent-posting drive at scale (over 7,700 contract medical officers and nurses given permanent posts in 2025, per a Dewan Rakyat answer 11 Feb 2026, with pay and on-call allowance increases), and gazetted the Control of Smoking Products for Public Health Act 2024 (in force 1 Oct 2024) though its "generational endgame" clause was dropped. Major delivery with one diluted reform (anchor 3).

citation.title: Over 7,700 contract docs and nurses given permanent posts last year, Dewan Rakyat told

metrics.justification: Established a Health Transformation Office (early 2024) to implement the Health White Paper's reform agenda. A standing reform body, but the White Paper itself predated his current term and public reporting on the office's output is thin, so institution-strengthening is weakly evidenced (anchor 2).

citation.title: MOH to set up Health Transformation Office to lead Health White Paper reforms — minister

metrics.justification: Explained the dropping of the smoking "generational endgame" on the parliamentary record (20 Mar 2024), saying it was removed on constitutional advice rather than lobbyist pressure, and engaged "privatisation" criticism of the Rakan KKM scheme with detailed on-record clarifications (14 Jul 2025). Reversals and contested decisions explained openly, though his and his deputy's accounts of the endgame diverged (anchor 3).

citation.title: GEG dropped due to constitutionality issue, not pressure from lobbyists, Dr Dzul tells Parliament
